Title: Designing a Lizard Habitat
Content: :box:Materials can be identified by their properties. `text(One)` property is how materials conduct heat. To compare the different materials, the students conduct an investigation to measure how quickly heat flows through `text(four)` different materials that could be used in the lizard habitat.

Students use `text(four)` containers made of `text(four)` different types of materials. They place `text(one)` ice cube in `text(each container)` and measure the amount of time it takes to melt. For the `text(four)` materials:

:ibox:• `text(Each container)` is the same volume.

• The ice cubes are the same size.

• Observations are collected `text(every minute)`.

• The total time it takes for the ice to melt is recorded.
